a.lede: The pCloud Pass password manager suffered a cyberattack, with users reporting that unknown devices had connected to their accounts even with two-factor authentication (2FA) enabled. [...]
a.title: pCloud confirms password manager hack after suspicious login alerts

b.lede: 1Password assures customers that their logins and other sensitive information were not compromised in a recent data breach.
b.title: 1Password says it was hacked but users' vaults are safe
